title: Prompt to playable vertical slice
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for prompt to playable vertical slice.

ordered_stages.action: Turn the prompt into testable pillars, constraints, and a minimal playable loop.
Create the smallest reversible implementation using placeholders first.
Integrate generated assets only after format and provenance checks.
Run deterministic smoke checks and representative player journeys.
Present build evidence and request human approval for the vertical slice.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
The core loop must be playable in a clean build.
Generated assets must not silently replace source assets.

fallbacks: Reduce scope to one mechanic and one level.
Keep placeholder art when generation rights or quality are unresolved.
